en_US: The Day-Care Man was saying Pokémon
grow at different rates.
It’s quite far from Solaceon Town to
Veilstone City.
There’s a café along the way where
you can get some rest, though.
The Hidden Machine Defog can be found
in the Solaceon Ruins.
But my Pokémon can’t learn the hidden
move.
I’m going to give the ruins a miss, this
time.
Pikachu!
I want to become more like a PIKACHU!
Will you battle me?
I need to find a way to get more into
the character of a Pokémon...
Maybe I should get the Day Care to
raise me?
Did you see Professor Rowan on the
TV? He said he may have spoken too
soon, about Team Eclipse.
When a man like that says maybe...
People start pinning up cards.
The Professor took it back, you
know. Called the station himself.
Said he was wrong.
...The cards are still on the wall.
